- If 2. Qxe3, the queen is centralized but potentially exposed to future attacks

This move also has the advantage of being forcing (it's check) and immediately addresses the threat to my bishop while creating counterplay.

Comparing this to other options:
- Trading on d4 gives White a good pawn center
- Retreating the bishop is passive and doesn't solve the fundamental issue
